notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which becomes a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
When Sword of the Meek leaves your battlefield, Tormod triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token, which becomes a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe.
Repeat from step 2.
